text: dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的量化基准工具插件，通过注册四个 DSH 工具连接基准运行、结果检查与报告撰写流程。它可按固定协议参数运行 ml-quant-trading 的 CPU 基准并写出 JSON 文件，读取结果并生成 Markdown 表格，检查协议字段、基准案例和方差提示，还能基于结果生成 GitHub issue 正文草稿。适合需要在 DSH 工作区复现并整理工程基准结果的开发者；需要准备目标仓库检出和 Python 环境，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark adds four DSH Web tools to run a fixed CPU benchmark, summarize JSON as a Markdown table, validate protocol fields, and draft an issue body. It helps reproduce engineering results. A target checkout and Python are needed; no API key is required.

基准跑完后，我想自动整理一份可提交的 GitHub 报告草稿。
怎样把 JSON 基准结果变成 Markdown 汇总表？
Can DSH run a fixed CPU benchmark and save its results as JSON?
I have a benchmark artifact; can DSH validate its protocol fields and cases?
dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark 的功能「运行 CPU 基准」：在 DSH 调用运行工具时，对目标仓库执行固定协议参数的 CPU 基准命令并写出 JSON 结果。
dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark 的功能「读取结果」：调用读取工具后解析基准 JSON，返回环境和原始结果，并渲染 Markdown 结果表与方差提示。
dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark 的功能「校验产物」：调用校验工具检查 JSON 的协议版本、固定环境参数、六个预期案例和结果行字段，返回错误与方差提示。
dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark 的功能「起草报告」：读取基准 JSON 后，可用传入的提交、版本和说明生成包含命令、环境、结果表和注意事项的 GitHub issue 正文草稿。

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark：The point is narrow: make a DSH agent able to run the existing benchmark, read
the machine-readable artifact, validate it against the benchmark protocol, and
draft an issue-ready report. This plugin does not add a trading agent, does not
call market data APIs, and does not configure any model provider.

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Why this exists：Challenge: can DeepSeek Harness reproduce a quant benchmark end to end, preserve
the evidence bundle, and avoid turning runtime numbers into alpha claims?

Listed in
[`awesome-dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
via [PR #2573](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/2573).

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Run-To-Report Path：1. Install the plugin from GitHub.
2. Open an `initial-d/ml-quant-trading` checkout in DSH.
3. Ask DSH to run, validate, summarize, and draft a benchmark report.
4. Submit the drafted report through the dedicated issue template.

That path is intentionally small: the plugin turns DSH attention into a
reproducible benchmark report, not an investment or leaderboard claim.

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `mlquant_benchmark_v1_cpu` | Run the fixed protocol v1 CPU benchmark and write `artifacts/benchmark-v1.json`. |
| `mlquant_read_benchmark_json` | Read the JSON artifact and render a compact Markdown result table. |
| `mlquant_validate_benchmark_json` | Check protocol v1 fields, expected cases, fixed parameters, and variance warnings. |
| `mlquant_draft_github_issue` | Draft a DeepSeek Harness benchmark issue body from the JSON artifact. It does not post to GitHub. |

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Install：Install the package in a DeepSeek Harness profile or preset environment:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:initial-d/dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark
```

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest that inserts:

```yaml
- id: mlquant-benchmark
  name: dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark
```

If you use a local checkout while developing, add the same row manually:

```yaml
- id: mlquant-benchmark
  name: file:/path/to/dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark
```

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Install：This package is intentionally not published to npm yet. GitHub distribution is
enough for the first DSH-facing benchmark reports; npm can come later if there
is real usage.

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test
```

The test loads the plugin with a mock `ctx.tools.register`, verifies that the
four tools register, reads and validates sample artifacts, and drafts an issue
body.

dsh-plugin-mlquant-benchmark README · Non-goals：- No investment advice.
- No backtest-performance claim.
- No hidden model provider configuration.
- No posting to GitHub from the tool.
- No private data or API keys in artifacts.
